definition: What we measure in seconds, minutes, hours and days.
exampleSentence: I never have enough time to finish all my homework on weekdays.

definition: A human being: a man, a woman or a child.
exampleSentence: She is the kindest person I have ever met in my life.

definition: A period of twelve months, or 365 days.
exampleSentence: We visit our grandparents in the village at least once a year.

definition: A method of doing something, or a road to a place.
exampleSentence: The fastest way to the airport is by train, not by taxi.

definition: A period of twenty-four hours.
exampleSentence: My favorite day of the week is Saturday because I can sleep late.

definition: An object, idea or action that you do not name exactly.
exampleSentence: The first thing I do every morning is drink a glass of water.

definition: An adult male person.

definition: The Earth and all the people and places on it.

definition: The time from birth until death, or the state of being alive.

definition: The part of your body at the end of your arm.

definition: A piece or section of something larger.

definition: A young person who is not yet an adult.

definition: The part of the face that you use to see.
exampleSentence: The doctor shone a small light into my left eye during the checkup.

definition: An adult female person.

definition: A particular area, position or location.

definition: A period of seven days.

definition: A particular situation, or a box that holds something.

definition: An idea or opinion, or the sharp end of something.

definition: The group of people who officially control a country.

definition: A business that sells goods or services.

definition: A word or symbol, such as 1, 2 or 3, that shows an amount.

definition: Several people or things that are together.

definition: A difficult situation that needs to be solved.

definition: Something that is known to be true.

definition: Coins and paper notes used to buy things.

definition: A building where a family or a group of people lives.

definition: The clear liquid in rivers, seas and rain that people drink.

definition: A space inside a building with walls, a floor and a ceiling.

definition: A female parent.

definition: A part of a city, a country or a surface.

definition: The time when it is dark, between evening and morning.

definition: A person you know well and like spending time with.

definition: A group of people related to each other, like parents and children.

definition: A sentence or phrase used to ask for information.

definition: A place where children go to learn.

definition: A large town where many people live and work.

definition: The word that a person, place or thing is called.

definition: A thought or a plan about what to do.

definition: A road vehicle with four wheels and an engine.

definition: A set of printed pages fastened together inside a cover.
exampleSentence: This book about ancient history was much more exciting than I expected.
